description: Ministry of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order recognize the International Institute of Health Science (Pvt) Ltd, as a Degree Awarding Institute for the Purpose of developing Higher Education
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Education exercising powers under the Universities Act to recognize a private institute as a degree-awarding institution. While it mentions a government minister (Prof. G. L. Peiris), it does not focus on government structure/personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about educational regulation and accreditation of a specific private institution, which falls under educational matters not covered by the specialized categories 4-9.
